fields.help_en:
The tag key.

If you do not specify this parameter, all tag keys are matched.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。


如果为空，则匹配所有标签键。

最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value.

If you do not specify the `Key` parameter, you do not need to specify this parameter. If you leave this parameter empty, all tag values are matched.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

标签键为空时，必须为空。如果为空，匹配所有标签值。

最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`

The ID of the security group to which the instance belongs.

This parameter is empty if the instance was created in the Message Queue for Apache Kafka console or by calling the [StartInstance]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157786.html） operation without a security group specified.

If a security group was specified when the [StartInstance]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157786.html） operation was called, this parameter returns the ID of that security group
